title: Text extractor moving screen contents
summary: Text Extractor overlays appear on the wrong displays in some multi-monitor configurations.

judgment.rationale: The report gives an actionable scenario, but the current failing boundary has not been established.
evidence: On 0.79 the reporter described three 1080p displays, with the right display duplicating the center and selection failing on other screens.
Multiple users reported similar behavior through 0.84.1; the thread includes diagnostic ZIPs and screenshots. Docked and direct connections are both mentioned.
Inspected src/modules/PowerOCR/PowerOCR/Services/OverlayManager.cs: the current implementation enumerates displays and captures each before creating overlays.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce on a current build and identify the first failing stage before choosing a targeted correction.

fix_assessment.rationale: A targeted correction may be applicable after the current failure is confirmed.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate multi-monitor Text Extractor overlays
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A monitor capture, display-bound or overlay-position mismatch could explain the historical symptom; the current failing stage is unknown.
plan: Reproduce the reported extended-display topology with a centered primary and the capture tool open on the right display.
Compare each display capture, physical bounds and overlay position, including negative-origin and mixed-DPI layouts.

Add focused coverage for multiple monitors, negative origins and mixed DPI.
verification: Every display shows its own dimmed content and selection works on each monitor.

confidence.rationale: The reported scenario is concrete but the current-build behavior and failing stage remain unknown.

reproduce.title: Investigate multi-monitor Text Extractor overlays
reproduce.version_requirement: Use the current PowerToys release and compare the reported version if practical.
prerequisites: Use a Windows test machine and preserve the original configuration.
setup: Use three extended 1080p displays side by side, with the center as primary; open Snipping Tool on the right.
steps: 2. Compare the dimmed image on each display with its pre-activation content and attempt selection on each.
3. Repeat with Snipping Tool closed and with a two-display configuration, recording monitor origins and scaling.
4. In a maintainer diagnostic session, compare capture identity and bounds with overlay windows.
reproduce.expected_result: Each monitor displays its own content and accepts selection in the correct coordinates.
